Load sheet version 3 bound 21 at its 4.56 GB planning figure, a planning cap rather than a runner limit; the runner planned 31, conditional on the configuration choice (approved_load_sheet.workers). The configuration trials' memory understates the full jobs' peaks (trials 0.554 GB, full jobs 1.968 GB at most). Observations for later load sheets, not a capacity binding.
